description: For service providers: list your public remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, HTTPS) on Ask Japan so its tools become available to every AI that connects to Ask Japan. The check is automatic: the URL must be public HTTPS, tools/list must work, and tool text must not contain instructions aimed at the AI. Returns approved or rejected with the reason.
